details: Bitcoin surged past $69,000 and Ethereum reclaimed $2,000, fueled by the U.S. Treasury's announcement to double longer-dated bond buybacks and the SEC's proposed new framework for crypto offerings. This market rally triggered liquidations of over $1.7 billion in Bitcoin short positions.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $69K, Ether Jumps 10% Amid Treasury Buybacks & SEC Proposal

details: Citi has introduced "Custody+", a new suite of real-time solutions for institutional investors, and plans to integrate Bitcoin custody services into this platform later this year. This will allow clients to access traditional and crypto custody within a unified framework.
title: Citi to Launch Institutional Bitcoin Custody with New 'Custody+' Platform

details: Tokyo-listed Metaplanet is extending its Bitcoin treasury strategy into the United States by acquiring a controlling stake in Nasdaq-listed Super League Enterprise. Metaplanet will contribute 2,100 BTC (valued at approximately $135 million) to the renamed "Superplanet," aiming to create new avenues for capital raising in the US.
title: Metaplanet Expands Bitcoin Treasury to US with Nasdaq Deal

details: Standard Chartered has significantly cut its end-2026 Bitcoin price forecast to $150,000 (from an earlier $300,000 projection) and its XRP target to $2.80 (from $8). The bank attributes these revisions to a recent market correction and now views ETF flows as the primary growth driver for crypto markets.
title: Standard Chartered Slashes Bitcoin and XRP Price Forecasts for 2026

details: The IRS has implemented a new Form 1099-DA, requiring crypto brokers to report gross proceeds from digital asset sales starting with 2025 transactions. Basis reporting for covered digital assets acquired after 2025 will also be phased in, signaling increased regulatory scrutiny on cryptocurrency taxation.
title: IRS Introduces New 1099-DA Form for Crypto Tax Reporting

details: Coinbase has rolled out a feature allowing users to borrow up to $100,000 against their Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP holdings. This provides an option for users to access liquidity without having to sell their digital assets.
title: Coinbase Enables Borrowing Against Crypto Holdings for Users
